# Data Source: catalyst_datastore_table

Read an existing Data Store table and column metadata. schema_json contains table_id, table_name and columns sorted by column_id (column_id, table_id, column_name, data_type, is_mandatory, is_unique, search_index_enabled and max_length). Defaults, creator profiles and row values are excluded. Requires table/column READ access. Table and column creation remain console prerequisites; this data source does not provision schemas. Denied access, null, incomplete or mismatched responses return an error. Live validation is limited to India Development.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" { type = string }
variable "table_id" { type = string }

data "catalyst_datastore_table" "site" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  id         = var.table_id
}

output "schema" { value = jsondecode(data.catalyst_datastore_table.site.schema_json) }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `id` (String) Existing table ID, written as a string.
- `project_id` (String) Existing project ID, written as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `name` (String) Verified table name reported by Catalyst.
- `schema_json` (String) Allowlisted table metadata as JSON. Use jsondecode to read its fields. Does not contain application data or default values.
